sentences.zh: 百官六

translations.literal: Official Posts, Part Six.
translations.idiomatic: Official Posts, Part Six.

sentences.zh: 大都留守司，秩正二品，掌守衛宮闕都城，調度本路供億諸務，兼理營繕內府諸邸、都宮原廟、尚方車服、殿廡供帳、內苑花木，及行幸湯沐宴遊之所，門禁關鑰啟閉之事。

translations.literal: The Dadu Metropolitan Garrison Commission, rank of the second positive grade, was charged with guarding the palace and capital city, coordinating the circuit's supplies and all related affairs, and concurrently managing repairs to inner-palace residences, the metropolitan ancestral temples, imperial workshops for chariots and regalia, hall furnishings and banners, inner-garden flowers and trees, and places for imperial travel, bathing, feasting, and excursions, as well as gate control, keys, and opening and closing.
translations.idiomatic: The Metropolitan Garrison Commission at Dadu held rank 2a. It guarded the palace and capital, coordinated the circuit's supplies and related duties, and also oversaw repairs to inner-palace residences, metropolitan ancestral temples, imperial workshops for vehicles and regalia, hall furnishings and banners, gardens within the palace, sites used for imperial travel, bathing, feasts, and outings, and the locking and opening of gates and keys.

sentences.zh: 至元十九年，罷宮殿府行工部，置大都留守司，兼本路都總管，知少府監事。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Zhiyuan, the Palace Works Office and its traveling Works Department were abolished, and the Dadu Metropolitan Garrison Commission was established, concurrently serving as route chief administrator and supervising the Palace Manufactories Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 19 (1282), the Palace Works Office and its traveling Works Department were abolished and the Metropolitan Garrison Commission at Dadu was created, combining the route chief administrator's role with supervision of the Palace Manufactories Directorate.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，別置大都路都總管府治民事，並少府監歸留守司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, a separate Dadu Route chief prefectural office was established to handle civil affairs, and the Palace Manufactories Directorate was returned to the Metropolitan Garrison Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 (1284), a separate Dadu Route chief prefectural office was set up for civil administration, and the Palace Manufactories Directorate was placed back under the Metropolitan Garrison Commission.

sentences.zh: 皇慶元年，別置少府監。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangqing, the Palace Manufactories Directorate was separately established.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangqing 1 (1312), the Palace Manufactories Directorate was established as a separate agency.

sentences.zh: 延祐七年，罷少府監，復以留守兼監事。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yanyou, the Palace Manufactories Directorate was abolished, and the metropolitan commissioner again concurrently supervised it.
translations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 7 (1320), the Palace Manufactories Directorate was abolished and its supervision was again assigned to the metropolitan commissioner.

translations.idiomatic: The Tax Levy Intendant's Office held rank 5a; two intendants; and one associate intendant, one vice intendant, and one document supervisor.

sentences.zh: 元貞元年置。

translations.literal: It was established in the first year of Yuanzhen.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Yuanzhen 1.

sentences.zh: 八作司，品秩職掌，悉與大都左右八作司同，達魯花赤一員，提領、大使、副使各一員。

translations.literal: The Eight Crafts Office: ranks, grades, and duties entirely the same as the Left and Right Eight Crafts Offices at Dadu; one darughachi, one superintendent, one director, and one vice director.
translations.idiomatic: The Eight Crafts Office matched the ranks, grades, and duties of the Left and Right Eight Crafts Offices at Dadu. It had one darughachi, one superintendent, one director, and one vice director.

sentences.zh: 至元十七年置。

translations.literal: It was established in the seventeenth year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Zhiyuan 17.

sentences.zh: 餼廩司，掌諸王駙馬使客飲食，大使一員，副使一員。

translations.literal: The Provisions Office, charged with food and drink for princes, imperial sons-in-law, envoys, and guests; one director, one vice director.
translations.idiomatic: The Provisions Office managed food and drink for princes, imperial sons-in-law, envoys, and guests. It had one director and one vice director.

sentences.zh: 至元二年，置上都應辦所。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhiyuan, the Shangdu Service Provision Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 2 the Shangdu Service Provision Office was established.

sentences.zh: 延祐五年，改為餼廩司。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yanyou, it was renamed the Provisions Office.
translations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 5 it was renamed the Provisions Office.

sentences.zh: 尚供總管府，秩正三品，掌守護東涼亭行宮，及遊獵供需之事。

translations.literal: The Palace Supply Directorate-General, rank of the third positive grade, guarded the Dongliangting traveling palace and managed supplies for hunting excursions.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Supply Directorate-General held rank 3a. It guarded the Dongliangting traveling palace and managed supplies for hunting excursions.

sentences.zh: 達魯花赤一員，總管一員，並正三品；

translations.literal: One darughachi and one chief administrator, both third positive grade;
translations.idiomatic: Darughachi and chief administrator: one post each at rank 3a;

sentences.zh: 同知一員，從四品；

translations.literal: Associate administrator, one post, fourth auxiliary grade;
translations.idiomatic: Associate administrator: one post at rank 4b;

sentences.zh: 副總管一員，從五品；

translations.literal: Deputy chief administrator, one post, fifth auxiliary grade;
translations.idiomatic: Deputy chief administrator: one post at rank 5b;

sentences.zh: 判官一員，正六品；

translations.literal: Judicial administrator, one post, sixth positive grade;
translations.idiomatic: Judicial administrator: one post at rank 6a;

sentences.zh: 經歷、知事、提控案牘各一員，令史、譯史、知印、奏差有差。

translations.literal: One each of administrative aide, case manager, and document supervisor; clerks, translators, seal keepers, and memorial envoys in varying numbers.
translations.idiomatic: One administrative aide, one case manager, and one document supervisor; clerks, translators, seal keepers, and memorial envoys in varying numbers.

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，置只哈赤八剌哈孫達魯花赤。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan, a Jiqachi Baraqsun darughachi was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 13 a Jiqachi Baraqsun darughachi was established.

sentences.zh: 延祐二年，改總管府。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yanyou, it was renamed a directorate-general.
translations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 2 it was renamed a directorate-general.

sentences.zh: 其屬附見。

translations.literal: Its subordinate offices are listed below.
translations.idiomatic: Its subordinate offices are listed below.

sentences.zh: 香河等處巡檢司，巡檢一員，司吏一人。

translations.literal: The Xianghe and other places Patrol Inspector's Office; one patrol inspector, one secretariat clerk.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianghe and other places Patrol Inspector's Office had one patrol inspector and one secretariat clerk.

sentences.zh: 景運倉，秩從五品，提點一員，從五品；

translations.literal: The Auspicious Transport Granary, rank of the fifth auxiliary grade; one intendant, fifth auxiliary grade;
translations.idiomatic: The Auspicious Transport Granary held rank 5b; intendant: one post at rank 5b;

sentences.zh: 大使一員，正六品；

translations.literal: One director, sixth positive grade;
translations.idiomatic: Director: one post at rank 6a;

sentences.zh: 副使一員，正七品。

translations.literal: One vice director, seventh positive grade.
translations.idiomatic: Vice director: one post at rank 7a.

sentences.zh: 至元二十一年置。

translations.literal: It was established in the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Zhiyuan 21.

sentences.zh: 法物庫，秩從九品，大使、副使各一員。

translations.literal: The Ritual Objects Storehouse, rank of the ninth auxiliary grade; one director and one vice director.
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Objects Storehouse held rank 9b with one director and one vice director.

sentences.zh: 至元二十九年置。

translations.literal: It was established in the twenty-ninth year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Zhiyuan 29.

sentences.zh: 雲需總管府，秩正三品，掌守護察罕腦兒行宮，及行營供辦之事。

translations.literal: The Cloud Supply Directorate-General, rank of the third positive grade, guarded the Chaghan Na'ur traveling palace and managed supplies for traveling camps.
translations.idiomatic: The Cloud Supply Directorate-General held rank 3a. It guarded the Chaghan Na'ur traveling palace and managed supplies for traveling camps.

sentences.zh: 達魯花赤一員，總管一員，並正三品；

translations.literal: One darughachi and one chief administrator, both third positive grade;
translations.idiomatic: Darughachi and chief administrator: one post each at rank 3a;

sentences.zh: 同知一員，從四品；

translations.literal: Associate administrator, one post, fourth auxiliary grade;
translations.idiomatic: Associate administrator: one post at rank 4b;

sentences.zh: 副總管一員，從五品；

translations.literal: Deputy chief administrator, one post, fifth auxiliary grade;
translations.idiomatic: Deputy chief administrator: one post at rank 5b;

sentences.zh: 判官一員，正六品；

translations.literal: Judicial administrator, one post, sixth positive grade;
translations.idiomatic: Judicial administrator: one post at rank 6a;

sentences.zh: 經歷一員，知事一員，提控案牘一員。

translations.literal: One administrative aide, one case manager, one document supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: One administrative aide, one case manager, and one document supervisor.

sentences.zh: 延祐二年置。

translations.literal: It was established in the second year of Yanyou.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Yanyou 2.

sentences.zh: 大都路都總管府，秩正三品，達魯花赤二員，都總管一員，副達魯花赤二員，同知二員，治中二員，判官二員，推官二員，經歷二員，知事二員，提控案牘四員，照磨兼管勾一員，令史九十有五人，譯史二人，回回令史一人，通事、知印各二人，奏差二十一人。

translations.literal: The Dadu Route chief prefectural office, rank of the third positive grade; two darughachi, one route chief administrator, two deputy darughachi, two associate administrators, two route supervisors, two judicial administrators, two judicial investigators, two administrative aides, two case managers, four document supervisors, one auditor concurrently serving as controller, ninety-five clerks, two translators, one Muslim clerk, two interpreters and two seal keepers each, twenty-one memorial envoys.
translations.idiomatic: The Dadu Route chief prefectural office held rank 3a; two darughachi, one route chief administrator, two deputy darughachi, two associate administrators, two route supervisors, two judicial administrators, two judicial investigators, two administrative aides, two case managers, four document supervisors, one auditor who also served as controller, ninety-five clerks, two translators, one Muslim clerk, two interpreters and two seal keepers, and twenty-one memorial envoys.

sentences.zh: 國初，為燕京路，總管大興府。

translations.literal: At the founding of the dynasty, it was the Yanjing Route, administering Daxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding of the dynasty it was the Yanjing Route, administering Daxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 中統五年，稱中都路。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhongtong, it was called the Central Capital Route.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongtong 5 it was called the Central Capital Route.

sentences.zh: 至元九年，改號大都。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan, its name was changed to Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 9 its name was changed to Dadu.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，始專置大都路總管府，秩從三品，置都達魯花赤、都總管等官。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, a separate Dadu Route chief prefectural office was first established at the third auxiliary grade, with chief darughachi, route chief administrator, and other officials appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 21 a separate Dadu Route chief prefectural office was first established at rank 3b, with chief darughachi, route chief administrator, and other officials appointed.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，升為都總管府，進秩正三品，領府一、州十有一。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, it was promoted to a route chief prefectural office, advanced to the third positive grade, governing one prefecture and eleven subprefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 27 it was promoted to a route chief prefectural office at rank 3a, governing one prefecture and eleven subprefectures.

sentences.zh: 凡本府官吏，唯達魯花赤一員及總管、推官專治路政，其餘皆分任供需之事，故又號曰供需府焉。

translations.literal: Of all officials in this office, only one darughachi, the chief administrator, and the judicial investigators exclusively handled route administration; the rest all shared supply-and-demand duties, so it was also called the Supply-and-Demand Office.
translations.idiomatic: Of all officials in this office, only one darughachi, the chief administrator, and the judicial investigators handled route administration exclusively; the rest all shared supply-and-demand duties, so it was also called the Supply-and-Demand Office.

sentences.zh: 其屬附見：

translations.literal: Its subordinate offices are listed below:
translations.idiomatic: Its subordinate offices are listed below:

sentences.zh: 大都路兵馬都指揮使司，凡二，秩正四品，掌京城盜賊奸偽鞫捕之事，都指揮使二員，副指揮使五員，知事一員，提控案牘一員，吏十四人。

translations.literal: The Dadu Route Metropolitan Troop-and-Horse Chief Commandant's Office, two in all, rank of the fourth positive grade, handled investigation and arrest of thieves, fraud, and rogues in the capital; two chief commandants, five vice commandants, one case manager, one document supervisor, fourteen clerks.
translations.idiomatic: The Dadu Route Metropolitan Troop-and-Horse Chief Commandant's Office, two in number, held rank 4a and handled investigation and arrest of thieves, fraud, and rogues in the capital. It had two chief commandants, five vice commandants, one case manager, one document supervisor, and fourteen clerks.

sentences.zh: 至元九年，改千戶所為兵馬司，隸大都路。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan, the thousand-household office was changed to the Troop and Horse Office, subordinate to the Dadu Route.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 9 the thousand-household office was changed to the Troop and Horse Office under the Dadu Route.

sentences.zh: 而刑部尚書一員提調司事，凡刑名則隸宗正，且為宗正之屬。

translations.literal: Moreover, one minister of justice supervised office affairs; all criminal cases were subordinated to the Court of Imperial Clan, and the office was also subordinate to that court.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, one minister of justice supervised office affairs; all criminal cases were subordinated to the Court of Imperial Clan, and the office was also subordinate to that court.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，置都指揮使等官，其後因之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, chief commandants and other officials were established; afterward this arrangement continued.
translations.idiomatic: In year 29 chief commandants and other officials were established; afterward this continued.

sentences.zh: 一置司於北城，一置司於南城。

translations.literal: One office was placed in the North City, one in the South City.
translations.idiomatic: One office was placed in the North City and one in the South City.

sentences.zh: 司獄司，凡三，秩正八品，司獄一員，獄丞一員，獄典二人，掌囚系獄具之事。

translations.literal: The Prison Directorate Office, three in all, rank of the eighth positive grade; one prison director, one prison assistant, two prison clerks; charged with detention and prison equipment.
translations.idiomatic: The Prison Directorate Office, three in number, held rank 8a; one prison director, one prison assistant, two prison clerks; it managed detention and prison equipment.

sentences.zh: 一置於大都路，一置於北城兵馬司，通領南城兵馬司獄事。

translations.literal: One was placed under the Dadu Route office, one under the North City Troop and Horse Office, jointly overseeing the prison affairs of the South City Troop and Horse Office.
translations.idiomatic: One was placed under the Dadu Route office and one under the North City Troop and Horse Office, jointly overseeing the prison affairs of the South City Troop and Horse Office.

sentences.zh: 皇慶元年，以兩司異禁，遂分置一司於南城。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangqing, because the two offices had different detention rules, a separate office was then placed in the South City.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangqing 1, because the two offices had different detention rules, a separate office was placed in the South City.

sentences.zh: 左、右警巡二院，秩正六品，達魯花赤各一員，使各一員，副使、判官各三員，典史各三人，司吏各二十五人。

translations.literal: The Left and Right Patrol and Inspection Courts, rank of the sixth positive grade; one darughachi each, one commissioner each, three vice commissioners and three judicial administrators each, three archive clerks each, twenty-five secretariat clerks each.
translations.idiomatic: The Left and Right Patrol and Inspection Courts held rank 6a; one darughachi each, one commissioner each, three vice commissioners and three judicial administrators each, three archive clerks each, and twenty-five secretariat clerks each.

sentences.zh: 至元六年置。

translations.literal: It was established in the sixth year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Zhiyuan 6.

sentences.zh: 領民事及供需，視大都路。

translations.literal: It oversaw civil affairs and supply-and-demand duties, as with the Dadu Route.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw civil affairs and supply-and-demand duties, as with the Dadu Route.

sentences.zh: 大德五年，分置供需院，以副使、判官、典史各一員主之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dade, a separate Supply-and-Demand Court was established, with one vice commissioner, one judicial administrator, and one archive clerk each in charge.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 5 a separate Supply-and-Demand Court was established, headed by one vice commissioner, one judicial administrator, and one archive clerk.

sentences.zh: 大都警巡院，品職分置如左、右院，達魯花赤一員，使一員，副使二員，判官二員，典史二員，司吏二十人。

translations.literal: The Dadu Patrol and Inspection Court, with ranks and posts divided like the Left and Right courts: one darughachi, one commissioner, two vice commissioners, two judicial administrators, two archive clerks, twenty secretariat clerks.
translations.idiomatic: The Dadu Patrol and Inspection Court was organized like the Left and Right courts: one darughachi, one commissioner, two vice commissioners, two judicial administrators, two archive clerks, and twenty secretariat clerks.

sentences.zh: 大德九年置，以治都城之南。

translations.literal: Established in the ninth year of Dade to govern the southern part of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Dade 9 to govern the southern part of the capital.

sentences.zh: 大都路提舉學校所，秩正六品。

translations.literal: The Dadu Route School Intendant's Office, rank of the sixth positive grade.
translations.idiomatic: The Dadu Route School Intendant's Office held rank 6a.

sentences.zh: 提舉一員，教授二員，學正二員，學錄一員。

translations.literal: One intendant, two professors, two school rectifiers, one school registrar.
translations.idiomatic: One intendant, two professors, two school rectifiers, and one school registrar.

sentences.zh: 至元二十四年，既立國學，以故孔子廟為京學，而提舉學事者，仍以國子祭酒系銜。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan, after the National University was established, the former Confucius Temple became the capital school, while the intendant overseeing school affairs still held the concurrent title of National University chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 24, after the National University was established, the former Confucius Temple became the capital school, while the intendant overseeing school affairs still held the concurrent title of National University chancellor.

sentences.zh: 管領諸路打捕鷹房總管府，秩正三品，達魯花赤一員，總管一員，副達魯花赤一員，同知一員，副總管一員，經歷、知事各一員。

translations.literal: The Chief Prefectural Office Overseeing Hunting and Falconry on All Routes, rank of the third positive grade: one darughachi, one chief administrator, one deputy darughachi, one associate administrator, one deputy chief administrator, one administrative aide and one case manager each.
translations.idiomatic: The Chief Prefectural Office Overseeing Hunting and Falconry on All Routes held rank 3a with one darughachi, one chief administrator, one deputy darughachi, one associate administrator, one deputy chief administrator, and one administrative aide and one case manager.

sentences.zh: 至元十七年置。

translations.literal: Established in the seventeenth year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Zhiyuan 17.

sentences.zh: 宛平縣，秩正六品，達魯花赤一員，尹一員，丞三員，主簿三員，尉一員，典史三員，司吏二十六人。

translations.literal: Wanping County, rank of the sixth positive grade: one darughachi, one magistrate, three assistants, three chief clerks, one commandant, three archive clerks, twenty-six secretariat clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Wanping County held rank 6a with one darughachi, one magistrate, three assistants, three chief clerks, one commandant, three archive clerks, and twenty-six secretariat clerks.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年置，治大都麗正門以西。

translations.literal: Established in the eleventh year of Zhiyuan, governing the area west of Dadu's Lizheng Gate.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Zhiyuan 11 and governed the area west of Dadu's Lizheng Gate.

sentences.zh: 大興縣，秩正六品，達魯花赤一員，尹一員，丞一員，主簿二員，尉一員，典史三員，司吏一十五人。

translations.literal: Daxing County, rank of the sixth positive grade: one darughachi, one magistrate, one assistant, two chief clerks, one commandant, three archive clerks, fifteen secretariat clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Daxing County held rank 6a with one darughachi, one magistrate, one assistant, two chief clerks, one commandant, three archive clerks, and fifteen secretariat clerks.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年置，治大都麗正門以東。

translations.literal: Established in the eleventh year of Zhiyuan, governing the area east of Dadu's Lizheng Gate.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Zhiyuan 11 and governed the area east of Dadu's Lizheng Gate.

sentences.zh: 東關廂巡檢司，秩從九品，巡檢三員，司吏一人，掌巡捕盜賊奸宄之事。

translations.literal: The East Gate Ward Inspection Office, rank of the ninth auxiliary grade: three inspectors, one secretariat clerk, charged with patrol and arrest of thieves and wrongdoers.
translations.idiomatic: The East Gate Ward Inspection Office held rank 9b with three inspectors and one secretariat clerk and handled patrol and arrest of thieves and wrongdoers.

sentences.zh: 至元二十一年置。

translations.literal: Established in the twenty-first year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: It was established in Zhiyuan 21.

sentences.zh: 西北、南關廂兩巡檢司，設置並同上。

translations.literal: The Northwest and South Gate Ward inspection offices were established with the same organization as above.
translations.idiomatic: The Northwest and South Gate Ward inspection offices were established with the same organization as above.
